snippet.title: 20 Days - Official Trailer #1
snippet.description:
This is the first official trailer for the game 20 Days, created by AgostonB.
You can add it to your wishlist on Steam now!

Survive 20 tense days aboard a failing spaceship while hunting down an enemy satellite. Every day brings new malfunctions, random story events, and difficult choices. Will you find the target before it's too late?
